The bib is constructed from translucent plastic or vinyl with colorful stitched edges (orange/red). It features a large, central appliqué design resembling a bouquet of flowers made from pink and white fabric scraps, green stems, and other mixed materials. The neck area has a loop closure mechanism made of layered fabric strips.

The layers of the neck strap appear to merge into each other without clear separation or logical attachment points. The geometry of the loop is slightly ambiguous, suggesting minor structural confusion in how the straps connect.
The orange stitching along the right edge wavers inconsistently, not following a smooth curve expected of a physical sewn edge, suggesting slight warping or generation instability.
